node.statement: Upper norm bootstrap. For nonzero X, the target C*-lower axiom and node 1.3.2.1 give (1-epsilon)||gamma_n(X)||^2 <= ||gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)|| <= (b_n+D e)||X||^2, because the source has ||X^dagger X||=||X||^2. Taking the supremum gives (1-epsilon)b_n^2<=b_n+D e. If b_n<=1 there is nothing to prove; otherwise, using epsilon<=e, b_n<=5, and e<=1, b_n(b_n-1)<=epsilon b_n^2+D e<=(25+D)e, hence b_n<=1+(25+D)e.
